neighbours.label: ' in' after a superlative or record that is measured against a span of time ('the coldest temperatures in decades', 'the highest level in years', 'the worst drought in a century'); the same sentences without a superlative stay quiet.
fire: The storm brought the heaviest snowfall in forty years.
Inflation hit its highest level in a decade.
The river fell to its lowest point in a century.
It was the worst harvest in living memory.
Stocks posted their biggest gain in months.
The town saw its warmest winter in years.
Unemployment fell to its lowest rate in decades.
It was the club's best season in a generation.
quiet: The storm brought heavy snowfall to the hills.
Inflation hit the shops hard this winter.
The river fell after the dry spell.
It was a poor harvest after the rain.
Stocks posted a gain on Monday.
The town saw a mild winter.
It was a good season for the club.
